Task: Add an existing product/service as a line item to the current invoice form by selecting it from a list/dropdown and inputting a quantity.
Expected Result: A new line item detailing the product/service, quantity, unit price, and calculated subtotal appears on the invoice form; the overall invoice total updates.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
